{{Quote|Peace and inner harmony follow consumption of a full bottle of Reserve."<br />"No. What comes after consumption of a full bottle of Reserve is called a hangover.|[[Ghitsa Dogder]] and [[Fenig Nabon]]|<ref name="A Credit for Your Thoughts">{{GamerCite|2|A Credit for Your Thoughts}}</ref>}}
A '''hangover''' was an unpleasant result of excessive [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] consumption. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] sometimes referred to a hangover as "[[Brandy Ague]]," and some [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Yuzzem]], had particularly long hangovers due to their species' size.

Hangovers could be cured by [[anti-veisalgia drug]]s, but continued excessive drinking gradually made these less effective.
